description: List a new harness on Loadbay. The repo MUST be a public, open-source GitHub repository. Optionally include a USDC address to receive tips — it must also appear in the repo's loadbay.json, .github/FUNDING.yml or README.md (proof of ownership). The listing appears immediately, tagged as community-added (unverified).

author.description: your GitHub handle (defaults to the repo owner)

baseUsdcAddress.description: Base USDC wallet (0x…) to receive tips — must also appear in the repo's loadbay.json, .github/FUNDING.yml or README.md

domain.description: domain key, one of: trading | coding | browser | productivity | data | social | health | science | gaming | media | robotics

repo.description: public GitHub repo URL — must be open source (have a license)

solanaAddress.description: Solana wallet (base58) to receive USDC (SPL) tips — optional, alongside or instead of Base

summary.description: what it connects to, what tools it exposes, how an agent uses it

name: submit_harness
title: Submit a harness to Loadbay
